newsitem.title: USA: Rubin sees solid US economic growth, low inflation.
newsitem.headline: Rubin sees solid US economic growth, low inflation.

text.p: Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin on Thursday said that the U.S. economy appeared to be on a path of solid growth with low inflation.
Speaking to reporters before testifying before a House Appropriations subcommittee, Rubin said, "I think we're really on a good track with the likely outcome one of solid growth with low inflation."

Rubin declined to discuss the high-flying stockmarket but said that his reading of Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan's remarks on Wednesday suggested he was "simply saying that people who invest need to look at the potential rewards and look at the potential risks to make sure they're conscious of both and weigh them appropriately."
Greenspan, in a semiannual Humphrey Hawkins testimony, said that investors should be cautious and not carried away in their investments with an over-amount of optimism.
